description: Returns the current status, time, service and provider for one grant-authorized booking reference. Client contact details and intake responses are excluded.

booking_ref.description: The reference create_booking returned (its idempotency key). Tampered, unrelated, cross-tenant or never-committed references answer one indistinguishable booking_not_found.

grant.description: The booking-bound capability token returned by create_booking. It must match this tenant and booking_ref and remain unexpired and unrevoked.

tenant.description: The tenant to operate on: the provider.tenant_slug value from the tenant's /.well-known/kirah.json manifest (the tenant's full domain, e.g. <slug>.kirah.ai).

name: get_booking_status
title: Get booking status
